context: Tests whether the agent correctly conducts Phase 1 of the hackathon coaching workflow — asking the three required questions one at a time, handling a user who lists multiple itches, matching the itch to a track, and enforcing the exit gate before declaring Phase 1 complete.

checklist.name: Phase announcement
checklist.description: The coach explicitly announces entering Phase 1 (e.g. 'Phase 1 — Interrogate' or equivalent phrasing indicating the phase name) before or at the start of the first question

checklist.name: Questions one at a time
checklist.description: The coach asks the stack question, the track question, and the itch question as separate turns — they are NOT all bundled into a single message

checklist.name: Stack question asked
checklist.description: The coach asks about the user's stack (language, framework, infra) as the first question

checklist.name: Track question asked
checklist.description: The coach asks Alex to pick one DevCon track (or describes the tracks so Alex can pick), as the second question

checklist.name: Itch question asked
checklist.description: The coach asks about one thing Alex secretly wishes existed (or similar phrasing), as the third question

checklist.name: Pushback on multiple itches
checklist.description: Since Alex lists three ideas upfront, the coach explicitly pushes back and asks Alex to pick one itch (e.g. 'Pick the one that makes you lean forward' or similar)

checklist.name: Single itch selected
checklist.description: The session concludes Phase 1 with exactly one named itch/idea selected (not a combination of the original three)

checklist.name: Track matched or clarified
checklist.description: The coach either confirms Alex's chosen track or (if unclear) names a track assignment with an explanation and gives Alex a chance to veto

checklist.name: Exit gate verified
checklist.description: The session log explicitly identifies that Phase 1 is complete and lists all three outputs: stack line, single track, single named itch — before moving to Phase 2

checklist.name: Voice and tone
checklist.description: The coach's messages are short and direct (no long paragraphs of padding), and do not include any apology for pushing back on Alex's multiple ideas
